paths.name: next/link
paths.message: A desktop app must not route. DesktopOS is mounted from _app.js on EVERY route, so it is a full-screen overlay that survives a client-side navigation: the new page renders UNDERNEATH it and the reader sees nothing happen. This shipped once, in the Blog app. Open detail views inside the window instead (see components/os/apps/Projects.js).

paths.name: next/router
paths.message: A desktop app must not PUSH a route — the desktop overlays every page, so the navigation is invisible. Reading the current route to decide what to show is the shell's job (components/os/DesktopOS.js), not an app's.
